snippet.title: STIFF NECK - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A story about the self—and about others.
A toy factory, several cursed dolls, and a horror novel… This quiet seaside town throws Noele's love life into chaos and dredges up the old wounds she has tried for years to forget.

The STIFF NECK playtest is scheduled to be released on November 22 at 7:00 PM (PT), available on Windows and macOS.

Search for 【STIFF NECK】on Steam and add it to your wishlist.
